title: Work Journal: entries become editable cards with a bold time, project chip, source tag and text bold up to the colon
story: Work Journal entries are now cards among free notes, each with a drag handle, a bold editable time, a changeable project chip, a fixed source tag and a delete cross, with text bold up to the first colon. Accept in the Suggestions box now adds a card instead of a plain 'HH:MM - text' line, and '+ Add entry' in the formatting toolbar adds a hand-made card. Pages written before this change keep their plain lines.

checks.criterion: Accept adds a card with the suggestion's time, project and source at the end of the page
checks.steps: Open the Work Journal on today's page with a pending made-up suggestion from a project and click its green tick.
checks.expected: A new card at the end with that time in bold, the project chip in the project's colour, the source tag and the text; the suggestion leaves the box.

checks.criterion: + Add entry adds an empty Typed card with the current time and the cursor in it
checks.steps: Click '+ Add entry' at the right end of the formatting toolbar and type 'Demo task: made-up detail'.
checks.expected: A card at the end with the current time, a dashed grey 'no project' chip and a 'Typed' tag; 'Demo task:' bold and the rest plain.

checks.criterion: Bold ends right after the first colon, or covers all text with no colon
checks.steps: In a card type 'Alpha: beta: gamma', then delete both colons.
checks.expected: First 'Alpha:' is bold, then the whole text is bold.

checks.criterion: Time and project can be changed
checks.steps: Click a card's time, type 9:05 and press Enter. Click its chip, pick an open project, then pick 'No project'.
checks.expected: The time shows 09:05; the chip takes the project's colour, then becomes the dashed 'no project' chip.

checks.criterion: Drag reorders; delete removes and Ctrl+Z restores
checks.steps: Drag a card by its handle between two free notes, click its cross, then press Ctrl+Z.
checks.expected: A red line shows where it lands and the card moves there; the cross removes it with no question; Ctrl+Z brings it back.

checks.criterion: A saved page with cards reloads the same, and an old page stays plain lines
checks.steps: Switch to another day and back, then open a day written before this change.
checks.expected: The cards are unchanged, and the old day's 'HH:MM - ...' lines are unchanged plain text.
